title: I get glimpses in the evenings
content: Idk about you guys but during the day I usually can barely remember my mallworld dreams. I can remember the setting but not the plot if that makes sense. However, in the evenings when im doing chores or showering etc. i get random flashes of what had happened in mallworld, accompanied by a sense of dread (almost like knowing you have a big project at work the next day.) Then when I fall asleep the storyline picks up. Anyone relate?
